subject.title: [Bug]: WebChat can render assistant reply before user prompt and duplicate inbound messages

question: Should #95566 remain a combined tracking issue until end-to-end WebChat proof covers both assistant-before-user ordering and duplicate inbound user context, or should maintainers split it across the narrower open WebChat items now?
rationale: Current source and related PRs show partial fixes and candidates, but automation cannot safely decide whether maintainers want this broad report retained or decomposed while #80670, #101494, #86946, and #69208 cover overlapping pieces.

options.title: Keep combined until proof
options.body: Leave #95566 open as a combined symptom tracker and require current-main or landed-PR proof that covers visible order, durable history, and model context before closure.

options.title: Split to canonical items
options.body: Close or narrow #95566 only after explicitly moving the user-turn durability piece to #86946/#80670 and the assistant duplicate piece to #85771/#101494.

options.title: Close as mitigated
options.body: Treat the shipped WebChat mitigations as sufficient and close this issue despite the lack of direct combined proof.

recommendation.title: Keep combined until proof
recommendation.body: Leave #95566 open as a combined symptom tracker and require current-main or landed-PR proof that covers visible order, durable history, and model context before closure.

likelyOwner.reason: The durable transcript and user-turn recorder path is the harder shared boundary and has the strongest current-history provenance for this issue.
